projects.title: LLM JUnit4 Unittest Generator
projects.blurb: Agentic Kotlin/JUnit4 test generator for Android Gradle modules. A Google ADK planner/coder/fixer pipeline drafts tests, runs them through Gradle and Kover (with optional JaCoCo), then repairs only the generated test code until the selected acceptance tasks pass — backed by a local llama.cpp server or a remote OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoint.
